decision: Retain the dry station/service yard. Its optional spur leads back to the already-reviewed R15 habitat; do not add decorative encounter grass without a native table or force habitat across the station facade, public conversations and shop.
scope_limit: This is a station outpost review, not new terrain or train-service publication. Native fixture tests prove specific visits and an actual R15 wild/RUN, not earned regional access or encounter balance.
